title: Five Little Ducks
source: YouTube official English captions checked locally; Chinese translation added for HelloLILI

cues.en: Five little ducks went out one day
cues.zh: 五只小鸭有一天出门去

cues.en: Over the hill and far away
Mother duck said, "Quack, quack, quack, quack"
But only four little ducks came back
cues.zh: 但是只有四只小鸭回来了
